svg.title: Jarvis software class diagram
svg.desc: Class and module diagram for the Jarvis FastMCP server, services, engineering database domain, notes domain, configuration, and external systems.
svg.text: Python · FastMCP · PostgreSQL · Git-backed Markdown notes
NotesReader and NotesWriter return NotesResult; LegacyNoteService returns NoteReadResult; NotesRepository may raise NotesRepositoryError.
